findings.violated_requirement: FR-022 / T008: permit a narrow passive project-agent TOML read for optional file-declared model/effort while preserving native dispatch authority.

findings.exact_correction: Within open T012 author an executable bounded native-result/metrics-failure orchestration harness or equivalent relevant seam test; inject helper/publication failure and assert original successful, question and failed native result plus routing and gate are preserved. Keep pending T010 implementation separate; prospective red tests may name the seam but must make substantive scenario assertions.
findings.observed_deficiency: The new test invokes inspect with no metrics publication or native child result. It compares unchanged steps/resolved inputs and cannot detect failed-emission replacement of native results or gates. No executable failure-isolation harness tests this requirement.
findings.violated_requirement: T012 workflow-result-preservation-tests / local-adapter Failure Isolation: failed emission retains original native result, routing, assignment and human gate.

findings.exact_correction: Handle bounded decoder resource failures at the ingestion/canonical-parser boundary as a bounded invalid-candidate category and continue to valid peers; add a focused deep-nesting regression under the 65536-byte limit. Do not emit raw payloads or host paths.
findings.observed_deficiency: A 3481-byte completed candidate containing a deeply nested unknown future field raises RecursionError from json.loads through parse_record_json; _read_candidate catches only ValueError. read_metric_records aborts rather than returning a per-candidate invalid count and valid peer.
findings.violated_requirement: T013 canonical-json-schema-validation / metrics-report Snapshot and Validation: invalid candidates are skipped individually and unknown fields ignored; usable peers remain available.

findings.exact_correction: Ensure ingestion classifies unsupported schema before other contract field deficiencies while retaining canonical validation; add a schema-version-plus-missing-field regression. If the shared-validator change is needed outside the current T013 source route, request the declared bounded Tasker correction route before that source effect.
findings.observed_deficiency: A readable UTF-8 completed file containing {"schema_version":2} returns invalid-contract rather than unsupported-schema because canonical validate_record checks all required fields before schema. Reproduced via read_metric_records.
findings.violated_requirement: T013 invalid-category-counts / metrics-report Snapshot and Validation: supported schema check precedes field validation.
